title: Characteristic function of a normalized correlated sum
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $t\in\mathbb R^2$. The characteristic function of the measure of the normalized sum of $n$ independent correlated sign vectors, with normalization $1/\sqrt n$, at $t$ equals $\displaystyle \left(\varphi\left(t/\sqrt n\right)\right)^n$, where $\varphi$ is the characteristic function of one correlated sign-vector measure.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is a point of the real correlation plane
caveat: At $n=0$, the formal expression uses the inverse square root of zero; the statement is preserved as the characteristic function identity specified by the Lean expression.
